Class InventoryItem

java.lang.Object
InventoryItem
public class InventoryItem extends Object
Represents an inventory item entity within the Inventory Management System. Encapsulates item attributes including name, quantity, and stock availability status, enforcing business validation rules and threshold-based status evaluation.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Haseeb Ahmad

  • Constructor Details

    • InventoryItem

      public InventoryItem(String name, int quantity, String status)
      Constructs an InventoryItem with explicit name, quantity, and stock status.
      Parameters:
      name - the item name (must not be null or whitespace-only)
      quantity - the stock quantity (must be a non-negative integer >= 0)
      status - the stock status ("In Stock", "Low Stock", or "Out of Stock")
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name is invalid, quantity is negative, or status is invalid

    • InventoryItem

      public InventoryItem(String name, int quantity)
      Constructs an InventoryItem with name and quantity, automatically deriving the stock status.
      Parameters:
      name - the item name (must not be null or empty)
      quantity - the stock quantity (must be non-negative)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if name is invalid or quantity is negative

  • Method Details

    • determineStatus

      public static String determineStatus(int quantity)
      Evaluates and returns the appropriate stock status based on current quantity thresholds.
      • quantity <= 0: "Out of Stock"
      • 1 <= quantity < 10: "Low Stock"
      • quantity >= 10: "In Stock"
      Parameters:
      quantity - the stock count to evaluate
      Returns:
      the corresponding stock status string

    • validateAndNormalizeStatus

      private static String validateAndNormalizeStatus(String status, int quantity)
      Normalizes and validates the status string against permitted constants. If null or empty, falls back to automatic derivation based on quantity.
      Parameters:
      status - the status string candidate
      quantity - the item's quantity
      Returns:
      the normalized valid status string
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an invalid custom status is supplied
